subject: Cheers!
author: brokengearbox
body:
Hello! Cheers a ton for the comments. I find the stunt runs more fun if you have to work for it... so I thought I should try a completely unsuitable car. Ive always done these runs at full speed... its the only way I know how.

I had to have a good lie down after this video... i was so worn out! you dont realise til afterwards how hard youve been concentrating!

brokengearbox... yet still competing!

subject: Speedy Stunt Run!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I think that was as stressful to watch as it was to play! I always play my stunt runs in a stunt car and I play at a much more sedate pace... you were really tearing around the city! There were a few moments when I thought you were gonna stack it, but you recovered just in time.

Nice Video! Thanks for that!! 🎬👍🙂

subject: Cool run
author: Xandu
body: I enjoyed watching your stunt run. When you started approching the beach and I saw how much time was left I kind of knew how it would end 😃. Shame that you missed that beach jump. Good score for being in a speed class car!
